$comment: Game feel for the Phaser layer (input gestures, pan, juice, HUD). Not part of the sim bundle or contentHash: nothing here changes a hunt's outcome (D-019). Times in ms, distances in design px, pan speeds in camera reference units per second.

quality.$comment: QualityManager tiers (Settings → quality; auto = the title-screen benchmark (M9) — 90 frames after a warm-up — else lowTierMaxCores-or-fewer coarse-pointer devices are low, the rest medium). Tiers only cut cost (particles, filters, a merged parallax layer, antialiasing), never what the player can see: secret glints and birds show on every tier.

accessibility.$comment: GDD §18.3. Reduce flashes: muzzle flash and hint glint alpha; the belt's red empty-click flash is off. Large flashes are capped at 3/s regardless. M9: large text scale, high-contrast outline width (fraction of the font size), sound captions (time on screen, lines at once, repeat gap).

ftue.$comment: Oupa se Les presentation (GDD §16): when the windpomp hint shows (fraction of the hunt), how long a step banner stays, and the longest prompt allowed (characters, one line).

assets.$comment: M10 asset manifest (docs/06-ASSET-DELIVERY.md): how long boot waits for the final-asset index, and for each final file, before that key stays on its procedural placeholder.

platform.$comment: Platform layer (Tech §8, M9): one deadline for a portal SDK's script + init at boot; the ad request timeout (until the SDK starts the ad; paused while the tab is hidden; no limit once the ad plays); error-report caps (no personal data: messages are trimmed, URLs reduced to file names).
